name: Normorphine
summary: Normorphine is an opiate analogue, the N-demethylated derivative of morphine, that was first described in the 1950s when a large group of N-substituted morphine analogues were characterized for activity.

pharmacology.text: The compound has relatively little opioid activity in its own right, but is a useful intermediate which can be used to produce both opioid antagonists such as nalorphine, and also potent opioid agonists such as N-phenethylnormorphine. with its formation from morphine catalyzed by the liver enzymes CYP3A4 and CYP2C8.

uses.text: The compound has relatively little opioid activity in its own right, but is a useful intermediate which can be used to produce both opioid antagonists such as nalorphine, and also potent opioid agonists such as N-phenethylnormorphine. with its formation from morphine catalyzed by the liver enzymes CYP3A4 and CYP2C8.

sideEffects.en: It has relatively little opioid activity of its own. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它本身的鴉片活性相當低。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它本身的鸦片活性相当低。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢。

fact.en: It was first described in the 1950s, when chemists made and tested a large set of morphine molecules altered at the nitrogen to see what each change did.
fact.zh: 它在 1950 年代首次被描述，當時化學家合成並測試了一大批在氮原子上做修飾的嗎啡分子，以了解每種改動的效果。
fact.zhHans: 它在 1950 年代首次被描述，当时化学家合成并测试了一大批在氮原子上做修饰的吗啡分子，以了解每种改动的效果。
